text:
Tara Chen: kicking off thread for BetaHealth POC. scope drift: customer now wants BYO-KMS + extractive summarization + semantic search + rerank. original POC was just rerank.
Mike Ortega: noted. big change. timeline still 2 weeks to demo? we need to rebaseline.
Tara Chen: they want a demo in 10 business days. also asked about pricing impact of dedicated vs hosted for heavy embeddings.
Rachel Gomez: ok need clear success criteria. propose: 1) avg summary ROUGE > baseline, 2) embeddings recall@10 >= 0.85 on our eval set, 3) tail latency p95 < 250ms for search path.
Mike Ortega: agree. add SLA for privacy: keys never leave customer VPC, BYO-KMS integration verified.
Sean Patel: BYO-KMS means Private deployment or dedicated with KMS tunnel. network access + firewall needs. security questionnaire outstanding.
Tara Chen: security team sent initial SSO/KMS matrix Tuesday. SecurityBot: security-q uploaded: https://redwood.internal/q/3456 (answers pending)
Mike Ortega: tradeoffs to call out to customer: 1) on-prem/BYO-KMS increases lead time by ~3-4 weeks, 2) dedicated reduces per-token cost at scale but needs commit, 3) lowest latency needs larger GPU shapes or longer batching windows.
Rachel Gomez: can we ship a two-phase POC? phase 1 hosted API for functional eval + eval prompts, phase 2 switch to dedicated/BYO-KMS for perf and privacy checks.
Tara Chen: they agreed to phased approach in sync call but want pricing for both. Mike, can you draft numbers?
Mike Ortega: rough numbers: hosted (pay-as-you-go) - $0.0008/token gen, embeddings $0.0006/vector; dedicated reserved (monthly) - starting $Xk/mo for 8xA10G w/ autoscale. will send spreadsheet.
Tara Chen: also need a short eval prompt set and instructions for their SMEs.
Mike Ortega: sending sample prompts now:
```
Prompt 1: "Given clinical note, extract key findings and produce a 3-sentence summary prioritized by diagnosis relevance."
Prompt 2: "Return top 5 similar cases from the corpus. Provide similarity score and reason clause."
```
Mike Ortega: and a curl to upload evals to our eval service:
```
curl -X POST https://evals.redwood/api/upload -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "file=@beta_health_eval.json"
```
Tara Chen: security question: will keys ever be visible to Redwood ops during private? Sean?
Sean Patel: for Private (VPC) control plane we do not store keys, we support customer KMS via kms-agent. logs are redacted by default. need SOC2 attestation to share.
Rachel Gomez: add success criteria for security: external pentest scheduled, KMS integration tested in staging, and policy review signed-off.
Mike Ortega: potential blocker: customers' firewall blocks outbound to our model registry for model downloads. mitigation: we can provide air-gapped model bundle or pre-load via scp.
Tara Chen: client asked whether we can run quantized int8 for cost. Mike: yes for many models, but quality regression margin ~1-3% on our evals. must include quantization flag in report.
Mike Ortega: recommend run: hosted baseline (fp16), then int8 dedicated run for cost comparison. include latency/cost per 1k queries.
Rachel Gomez: I'll draft the POC one-pager with timeline, success criteria, pricing options, and blockers. Tara, can you confirm stakeholders and sign-off list?
Tara Chen: stakeholder list: Dr. Alvarez (medical lead), Priya (IT security), Marcus (product). I'll get signatures by EOD tomorrow.
SecurityBot: reminder: please attach completed security questionnaire to the thread when ready. :memo:
Mike Ortega: action items: 1) send pricing spreadsheet (today), 2) upload sample eval JSON (today), 3) set staging BYO-KMS test (Sean/this week), 4) Rachel to share one-pager (tomorrow).
Tara Chen: thanks team. we'll update the customer after we have pricing + eval upload. :thumbsup:
Rachel Gomez: noted, will share draft in #sales tomorrow.
Sean Patel: starting KMS staging task now, tag me for firewall details.
